newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Finance&Mining proposes Molins Cement merger.
newsitem.headline: Spain Finance&Mining proposes Molins Cement merger.

text.p: Spain's Sociedad Financiera y Minera will propose to shareholders of Cementos Molins that a viability study be conducted on a possible merger between the two companies, the stock market watchdog CNMV said on Thursday.

At Cementos Molins' annual general meeting, the chairman of Financiera y Minera, which owns 25.34 percent of the former, called an extraodinary meeting to be held before July 26 to present the proposal to shareholders.

"Financiera y Minera believes that a possible merger is an excellent opportunity for both companies and shareholders due to their complementary activities and the synergies that would result form the merger," Financiera y Minera said in a statement presented to the CNMV.
But board members at Cementos Molins appeared to be surprised by the proposal.

"The majority of board members are surprised by the manner in which (Financiera y Minera) has presented this, and express their disagreement and opposition with respect to the suitability and opportunity of the proposal," Cementos Molins said in a statement submitted to the CNMV.
